PS Plus monthly games for December 2026

Sony has announced the monthly games for December 2026. They're free to claim with any PS Plus tier, including Essential, from Tuesday 1 December 2026. Until then you can still claim November's games, below.

Coming Tuesday 1 December 2026

  • Amnesia: The Bunker

    First-person horror · PS4 · Metascore 73 · about 5.5 h main story

    A first-person horror game set in a First World War bunker, where you're hunted by a monster while keeping a generator running so the lights stay on. It's shorter than the earlier Amnesia games, but the layout and item locations change each time, so it's built to be replayed.

    PlayStation StoreTrailersReviews

  • Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2

    Action RPG fighter · PS4 and PS5 · Metascore 72 · about 20 h main story

    An action RPG where you create your own fighter and travel through Dragon Ball history to fix things that have gone wrong. The story is long enough on its own, and there's years of added content and online raids on top of that.

    PlayStation StoreTrailersReviews

  • Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4 – Cross-Gen Edition

    Skateboarding · PS4 and PS5 · Metascore 82 · about 8 h main story

    A remake of the third and fourth Tony Hawk games, built on the same engine as the 1+2 remake, with new parks, more skaters and online play. The fourth game's open career has been squeezed into the same two-minute runs as the third, which longtime fans have mixed feelings about.

    PlayStation StoreTrailersReviews

The lineup is different in parts of Asia this month. In Japan, Bleach: Rebirth of Souls replaces Amnesia: The Bunker, and in Taiwan and Hong Kong, Hello Neighbor replaces it. Korea gets two games, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 and Hello Neighbor.

Claim now: November's games

Claim these by Monday 30 November 2026 (3 days left). Once claimed, they're yours to play for as long as you're a PS Plus member, on any tier. Adding them to your library is enough; you don't need to download them.

  • Dead Island 2

    PS4 and PS5 · Metascore 73 · about 16 h main story

    Like its predecessor, Dead Island 2 is an action role-playing game played from a first-person perspective. While players can play the game solo, it also supports three-player cooperative multiplayer.

    PlayStation StoreTrailersReviews

    Find it on the wall

  • Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered

    PS4 and PS5 · Metascore 70 · about 28 h main story

    Like the previous Tomb Raider titles, each game features archaeologist-adventurer Lara Croft exploring a majority of locations in search of ancient artifacts, and is presented from a third-person perspective.

    PlayStation StoreTrailersReviews

    Find it on the wall

  • Monster Train 2

    PS5 · Metascore 87 · about 5.3 h main story

    PlayStation StoreTrailersReviews

    Find it on the wall
